'''October 2001 Ottawa tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada on 20 October 2001. It is known from Thomas Dowling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3065">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-20-ottawa-canada-20-10-01d3065/ ottawa-canada-20-10-01], DeckTech (Thomas "COTEB" Dowling, 20 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-20-ottawa-canada-20-10-01d3065/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Ottawa, Ontario, Canada
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 8
